Class MoreTypes

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.processing.MoreTypes
public final class MoreTypes extends Object
Checks and conversions on TypeMirrors that javax.lang.model does not provide.

  • Method Details

    • isType

      public static boolean isType(TypeMirror type, Class<?> clazz)
      Returns whether a type is the type of a class, ignoring type arguments: List<String> is List.class.
      Parameters:
      type - the type to check
      clazz - the class, which may be primitive or an array
      Returns:
      true if type is clazz

    • isType

      public static boolean isType(TypeMirror type, String qualifiedName)
      Returns whether a type is the declared type of a name, ignoring type arguments.
      Parameters:
      type - the type to check
      qualifiedName - the canonical name of a class, interface, enum, record or annotation type
      Returns:
      true if type is a declared type of that name

    • asDeclared

      public static Optional<DeclaredType> asDeclared(TypeMirror type)
      Returns a type as a declared type, if it is one.
      Parameters:
      type - the type
      Returns:
      the declared type, or empty for a primitive, array, type variable or any other kind of type

    • asTypeElement

      public static Optional<TypeElement> asTypeElement(TypeMirror type)
      Returns the element of a declared type.
      Parameters:
      type - the type
      Returns:
      its class, interface, enum, record or annotation type, or empty if it is not a declared type
